eyebrow: One stage carries dead weight into production
code:
FROM node:20
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install
RUN npm run build      # produces /app/dist
CMD ["npx", "serve", "dist"]
caption: The compiler, every dev dependency, and the unbuilt source all ship -- for an app that's just static files.

eyebrow: Build stage: the full Node toolchain
code:
# ---- build stage ----
FROM node:20 AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .
RUN npm run build
caption: FROM ... AS build names this stage -- it exists only to produce /app/dist.

code:
# ---- runtime stage ----
FROM nginx:1.27-alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
EXPOSE 80
caption: A fresh, minimal image -- COPY --from=build pulls out only the compiled files, nothing else.

code:
$ docker images northbridge/catalog-frontend
REPOSITORY                     TAG   SIZE
northbridge/catalog-frontend   1.0   48.2MB
caption: Versus 900MB+ single-stage -- the build stage ran npm install and npm run build, but none of its weight ships.

subtitle: Slim bases, .dockerignore, and minimizing layers -- more ways to keep images lean.
